summary: Join our M&E training course to master data visualization techniques. Learn to present data clearly and effectively for better decision-making and insights.
lede: M&E data visualization helps monitoring and evaluation teams turn indicator data into clear charts, scorecards, and dashboards for programme decisions. It is designed for professionals who collect, analyze, manage, or communicate M&E evidence, and covers checking data quality, preserving disaggregation, and selecting visuals that show targets and baselines. Participants practise building Excel scorecards and Power BI dashboard prototypes, then interpreting results with annotations that explain evidence and limitations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who collect, analyze, manage, or communicate monitoring and evaluation evidence. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who need stronger visualization practice without requiring programming or advanced statistical training.
audience: Learning and Adaptation Leads using visual evidence
modules: M&E Dashboard Design in a BI Tool
BI Tool and Digital Reporting Workflows
prerequisites: Prerequisites: You should have basic experience with programme indicators, monitoring reports, or evaluation activities. Familiarity with spreadsheets is useful, but advanced statistics, database administration, and programming are not required. Completion does not require coding. Advanced digital topics such as BI data relationships, automated refresh, and AI-assisted chart suggestions receive operational application and guided practice rather than technical engineering depth.
